## Variables

<a name="ErrNoHomeDir"></a>ErrNoHomeDir is returned when no safe home directory can be determined.

```go [tako.go]
var ErrNoHomeDir = errors.New("tako: cannot determine a safe home directory; set TAKO_HOME or TAKO_APP_DIR")
```

<a name="GetHomeDir"></a>
## func [GetHomeDir](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/path.go#L16>)

```go [path.go]
func GetHomeDir() string
```

GetHomeDir returns the base directory for Tako configuration and data. Priority: TAKO\_APP\_DIR \(project\-local\) → TAKO\_HOME → \~/.tako. Returns an error instead of falling back to the current working directory, which could be attacker\-controlled.

<a name="HomeDirErr"></a>
## func [HomeDirErr](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/path.go#L23>)

```go [path.go]
func HomeDirErr() (string, error)
```

HomeDirErr is like GetHomeDir but surfaces the error when no safe path can be resolved. Callers that need to handle failure explicitly should use this.

<a name="Context.Commands"></a>
### func \(\*Context\) [Commands](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/context.go#L137>)

```go [context.go]
func (c *Context) Commands(cmds ...any) *Context
```

Commands fluently registers one or more CLI commands from a plugin. It accepts \`any\` to prevent cyclic dependencies with the \`cli\` package, but safely casts to \`cli.Command\` internally.

```
ctx.Commands(&MyCommand{}, &AnotherCommand{})
```

<a name="Context.Keys"></a>
### func \(\*Context\) [Keys](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/context.go#L116>)

```go [context.go]
func (c *Context) Keys() *builders.KeyBuilder
```

Keys returns a KeyBuilder for registering keybindings fluently from a plugin.

Global key:

```
ctx.Keys().Bind("ctrl+f", handler)
```

Zone key \(level 0 by default\):

```
ctx.Keys().Zone("main").Bind("j", handler)
```

Zone key with explicit stack level:

```
ctx.Keys().Zone("main", 1).Bind("j", handler)
```

<a name="Context.Mouse"></a>
### func \(\*Context\) [Mouse](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/context.go#L128>)

```go [context.go]
func (c *Context) Mouse() *builders.MouseBuilder
```

Mouse returns a MouseBuilder for registering mouse zones and handlers from a plugin.

```
// Register hitbox (call every render)
ctx.Mouse().UpdateHitbox("list", x, y, w, h)

// Register handlers
ctx.Mouse().Zone("list").OnClick(func(x, y int) { ... })
ctx.Mouse().Zone("list").OnDrop(func(from string, x, y int) { ... })
```

<a name="Context.Once"></a>
### func \(\*Context\) [Once](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/context.go#L201>)

```go [context.go]
func (c *Context) Once(event string, handler contracts.EventHandler)
```

Once registers a handler that fires exactly once for the given event, then auto\-unsubscribes. Syntactic Sugar for ctx.Events\(\).Once\(ctx, ...\).

Fluent style \(recommended\):

```
ctx.Once("app:ready", func(e contracts.Event) {
    p.initUI()
})
```

Alternative \(direct bus access\):

```
ctx.Events().Once(ctx, "app:ready", func(e contracts.Event) {
    p.initUI()
})
```

<a name="Context.Overlay"></a>
### func \(\*Context\) [Overlay](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/tako/context.go#L168>)

```go [context.go]
func (c *Context) Overlay() contracts.OverlayManager
```

Overlay returns the resolved OverlayManager from the container. It is the single high\-level entry point for all layer management in plugins: basic overlays, component overlays, and dialog primitives.

```
// Basic overlay
ctx.Overlay().Show("search", func() any { return searchView })
ctx.Overlay().Close()

// Component overlay
ctx.Overlay().ShowComponent(&SearchBox{})

// Dialog (sub-namespace via Dialog())
ctx.Overlay().Dialog().Confirm("Sure?", func(yes bool) { ... })
```
